articles.title: Woman Teacher Paraded and Assaulted by Husband, Mob Over Alleged Affair
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a shocking case of mob justice, a female teacher was assaulted and paraded through the streets by her husband and his associates in Nimapara, Puri district, Odisha, over allegations of an extra-marital affair.

body.html:
In a shocking case of mob justice, a female teacher was assaulted and paraded through the streets by her husband and his associates in Nimapara, Puri district, Odisha, over allegations of an extra-marital affair.

The disturbing incident occurred on Tuesday night when the woman’s husband, a college lecturer, along with friends, allegedly broke into her rented house around 8 p.m. They claimed to have found her with a male friend, a student leader, in a compromising position.

Enraged, the husband dragged both out of the house. The teacher was garlanded with shoes, slapped, abused, and forced to walk towards the police station amid a jeering crowd. The male companion too was humiliated as onlookers filmed the ordeal instead of intervening.

The video of the assault has since gone viral, triggering widespread outrage over the public violation of the woman’s dignity. Reports suggest the teacher had been staying separately from her husband due to marital disputes.

Police confirmed that a case has been registered and the woman’s husband, along with two others, have been detained for interrogation. The investigation is ongoing.

articles.title: Hospital Staffer Dies After Scooter Hits Pothole on NH-66, Run Over by Speeding Lorry
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 44-year-old woman, Madhavi, resident of Surathkal Kulai and an employee of AJ Hospital, Kundikana, died instantly in a tragic road accident on the morning of September 9, 2025, near the Kulur flyover on National Highway-66.

body.html:
A 44-year-old woman, Madhavi, resident of Surathkal Kulai and an employee of AJ Hospital, Kundikana, died instantly in a tragic road accident on the morning of September 9, 2025, near the Kulur flyover on National Highway-66.

At around 8:30 a.m., Madhavi was riding her scooter from Kulai towards Kuntikana when it struck a large pothole, causing her to lose balance and fall onto the road. A fish-laden lorry, allegedly speeding and driven by Mohammed Farooq, ran over her, killing her on the spot.

Disturbing CCTV footage of the accident has since gone viral, sparking public outrage and highlighting years of neglect in highway maintenance. Locals say repeated complaints about dangerous potholes in the area were ignored, despite multiple accidents. Madhavi is the fifth fatality blamed on potholes in this stretch alone.

In response, authorities rushed to repair some potholes. Police Commissioner Sudheer Kumar Reddy confirmed that cases have been filed against both the lorry driver and officials of the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) for criminal negligence.

The case has been registered under Sections 281 and 106(1) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) and Section 198(A) of the Indian Motor Vehicles Act.

The tragedy underscores persistent failures in road safety, civic responsibility, and accountability, with locals demanding strict action to prevent further loss of lives.

articles.title: Schoolgirl’s Accident Sparks Protests, Topples PM Oli in Nepal Political Crisis
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: On 6 September 2025, an official jeep linked to Koshi Province Minister Ram Bahadur Magar struck 11-year-old Usha Magar Sunuwar outside Harisiddhi Secondary School in Lalitpur.

body.html:
On 6 September 2025, an official jeep linked to Koshi Province Minister Ram Bahadur Magar struck 11-year-old Usha Magar Sunuwar outside Harisiddhi Secondary School in Lalitpur. The crash, caught on CCTV, showed the girl being flung to the roadside as the vehicle sped away without stopping.

She survived with injuries and was admitted to hospital. The ruling party pledged to cover her medical expenses, with formal statements of regret. But what ignited mass outrage was Prime Minister K P Sharma Oli’s description of the collision as a “normal accident.”

Locals staged immediate protests by blocking roads, accusing authorities of negligence and indifference. Soon, the accident became a lightning rod for nationwide anger over nepotism, corruption, and youth unemployment.

Social media campaigns under hashtags like #PoliticiansNepoBabyNepal and #NepoBabies mobilised young protesters, who demanded accountability, lifting of the social media ban, and an independent corruption watchdog.

Demonstrations spread to Kathmandu, with thousands rallying outside Parliament. The public fury eventually played a decisive role in the ouster of PM Oli, reshaping Nepal’s political landscape.

Today, while Usha’s recovery continues, her case remains a symbol of resistance, fuelling ongoing demands for political reform and accountability in Nepal.

articles.title: Hyderabad Horror: 6-Year-Old Girl Falls Into Open Manhole in Yakutpura – Narrowly Escapes Death!
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A major tragedy was averted in Hyderabad’s Yakutpura today after a 6-year-old girl fell into an open manhole while walking to school. The incident, caught on CCTV, shows the child slipping into the uncovered pit.

body.html:
A major tragedy was averted in Hyderabad’s Yakutpura today after a 6-year-old girl fell into an open manhole while walking to school. The incident, caught on CCTV, shows the child slipping into the uncovered pit.

Her mother, who was walking right behind, acted swiftly and pulled her out, saving her life.

According to locals, the manhole was left uncovered by the HYDRAA team, which had opened it for cleaning yesterday but failed to close it back properly. GHMC has been held responsible for negligence.

Thankfully, there was no water flow inside the manhole at the time, allowing the child to escape with only minor injuries.

articles.title: Canteen Operator at Kanpur Hospital Ran Sex Racket Using Blackmail; Nude Videos of 20 Girls Recovere
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: KANPUR: The operator of a private hospital canteen in Naubasta is accused of raping a minor, creating nude videos of approximately 20 girls, and operating a sex racket by blackmailing them, police reported on Thursday.

body.html:
KANPUR: The operator of a private hospital canteen in Naubasta is accused of raping a minor, creating nude videos of approximately 20 girls, and operating a sex racket by blackmailing them, police reported on Thursday.

The incident came to light when the father of a 14-year-old victim caught the accused, identified as Keshav Uttam, a resident of Fatehpur Jahanabad, forcibly taking his daughter. Upon confronting him, a scuffle ensued during which the accused's mobile phone fell to the ground.

The victim, who knew the phone's password, unlocked the device. Her father was horrified to find her nude video stored on it, alongside explicit photos and videos of numerous other young women.

According to the police complaint, the accused had lured the minor to the hospital on a pretext months ago, where he allegedly raped her and recorded the assault. He then used the video to blackmail and repeatedly assault her, threatening to leak the footage.

A preliminary investigation of the mobile also revealed audios and WhatsApp chats suggesting the operation of an organised sex racket. In these exchanges, individuals are allegedly heard demanding specific girls from the accused.

Based on the father's complaint, the Naubasta police have registered an FIR against Keshav Uttam under relevant sections, including molestation, assault, hostage-taking, and the stringent POCSO Act. Two police teams have been formed to apprehend the accused, who is currently absconding.

DCP South, Dipendra Nath Chaudhary, confirmed the case and stated that efforts are underway to contact the other victims whose videos were found on the phone. Further complaints are expected to be registered.

articles.title: Bar Dancers’ ‘Obscene’ Performance at Khereshwar Mahadev Temple During Dev Chhath Fair
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Aligarh (Uttar Pradesh) – A major controversy has erupted after videos surfaced showing bar dancers performing at the historic Khereshwar Mahadev Temple during the Dev Chhath fair.

body.html:
Aligarh (Uttar Pradesh) – A major controversy has erupted after videos surfaced showing bar dancers performing at the historic Khereshwar Mahadev Temple during the Dev Chhath fair. The dancers, some reportedly of foreign origin, were seen performing in what many have described as an “obscene” manner on a stage set up inside the temple premises.

According to locals, while cultural programmes have been part of the Dev Chhath fair for years, this time organisers allegedly hired bar dancers instead. Videos circulating on social media show organisers and crowds openly enjoying the performances, sparking massive criticism.

Devotees and locals have accused the organisers of hurting religious sentiments by allowing such shows in a sacred space. “This is playing with our culture and faith. Such programmes must be opposed in temples,” one agitated devotee said.

The videos have gone viral online, with many netizens even dubbing the act as “Russian Mujra at the temple.” The incident has triggered widespread anger, and demands are growing for strict action against the organisers.

articles.title: Baghpat Horror: Woman Kills 3 Daughters, Then Hangs Herself Amid Family Dispute
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Baghpat (Uttar Pradesh) – A heart-wrenching incident has shaken Tikri town in Doghat police station area, where 29-year-old Tej Kumari killed her three daughters before ending her own life.

body.html:
Baghpat (Uttar Pradesh) – A heart-wrenching incident has shaken Tikri town in Doghat police station area, where 29-year-old Tej Kumari killed her three daughters before ending her own life.

According to police, the woman strangled her children — 7-year-old Gunjan, 2-year-old Kitto, and 5-month-old Meera — with a dupatta. After committing the crime, she hanged herself from the ceiling fan with the same cloth.

On receiving information, Doghat police broke open the door in the presence of videography. Inside, Tej Kumari was found hanging, while the bodies of the three children lay on the bed with dupattas tied around their necks.

Her husband Vikas, a bus driver in Delhi, was reportedly outside the house at the time. Police said there had been disputes between the couple, with the woman insisting on moving to the city for the children’s education, which her husband opposed. SP Baghpat Suraj Kumar Rai confirmed that the couple had not spoken for 24 hours before the incident.

The tragedy has left the village in mourning. Police have sent the bodies for post-mortem and launched a detailed investigation.

articles.title: Rae Bareli: Man Arrested for Posting AI-Generated Video of PM Modi and Italian PM Meloni
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Rae Bareli (Uttar Pradesh) – Police have arrested Durgesh Kumar for allegedly uploading an AI-generated video featuring Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni on social media.

body.html:
Rae Bareli (Uttar Pradesh) – Police have arrested Durgesh Kumar for allegedly uploading an AI-generated video featuring Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni on social media.

Officials confirmed that the video was digitally manipulated and shared online with the intent to mislead. Following complaints, Rae Bareli police traced the source and took Kumar into custody.

Authorities have urged the public to exercise caution while sharing AI-generated or morphed content, warning that strict action will be taken against those spreading misinformation.
